I’ve been focusing on retweeting black folk I follow on here in regards to protest commentary (for obvious reasons), but I’ll say what only needs to be said once:

Promote black voices. Listen to them. Watch their backs. Learn when to shut up. #BlackLivesMatter Fuck cops.

And let us always remember, as our fellows protest racial injustice across the country, that Black members of #SBC churches face greater challenges when reporting abuse in a church and country that sees them as lesser beings.
#SBCadvance #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/KCmXrpU9tZ
